fullTextEN: Hello everyone,
I am Nika.
I come from Anhui, China,

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: I currently live in Hefei, Anhui Province.
Do you love drinking coffee?

fullTextZH: 你知道中国最火的咖啡店是什么吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what the most popular coffee shop in China is?
Is it Starbucks from America?
No, it's a Chinese company,
It's called Luckin Coffee.

fullTextZH: 为什么这个公司这么火？
fullTextEN: Why is this company so popular?

fullTextZH: 今天我们聊聊这个中国很火的咖啡品牌
fullTextEN: Today we talk about this very popular Chinese coffee brand
Luckin Coffee.

fullTextZH: 现在，在中国到处都能看到它的店。
fullTextEN: Now, you can see its stores everywhere in China.
You might ask, hmm,

fullTextZH: 中国人不是更喜欢喝茶叶吗？
fullTextEN: Don't Chinese people prefer drinking tea?

fullTextZH: 为什么瑞幸咖啡这么火？
fullTextEN: Why is Luckin Coffee so popular?

fullTextZH: 其实，现在的中国年轻人，
fullTextEN: Actually, now many young Chinese people,
drink a lot of coffee.
I also love drinking it.
The first thing I do when I go out every day,

fullTextZH: 就是去瑞幸买一杯咖啡。
fullTextEN: It's just going to Luckin to buy a cup of coffee.

fullTextZH: 但是，在以前我们喝星巴克更多。
fullTextEN: However, we used to drink Starbucks more.

fullTextZH: 但是现在，基本上大家都会买瑞幸。
fullTextEN: But now, basically everyone buys Luckin.
When I was little,
Starbucks was very popular in China.
But in the place where I was born,

fullTextZH: 十年前才开了第一家星巴克。
fullTextEN: The first Starbucks opened only ten years ago.
Everyone rushed to buy coffee,
taking photos and chatting.

fullTextZH: 那时候，中国的咖啡品牌很少很少。
fullTextEN: At that time, there were very few Chinese coffee brands.

fullTextZH: 想喝咖啡，只能去星巴克。
fullTextEN: If you wanted coffee, you could only go to Starbucks.
Starbucks coffee was very expensive,
It was about more than 30 RMB,
A cup was about four dollars.
Ten years ago, I was still a student,
I couldn't afford it every day.

fullTextZH: 去喝一杯的时候，一定会穿得很漂亮，
fullTextEN: When going for a cup, I would definitely dress nicely,
and also take photos.

fullTextZH: 那时候的星巴克生意很好，
fullTextEN: At that time, Starbucks business was very good,
often with queues.
As for Luckin Coffee,
It only opened its first store in 2017.
Luckin's stores are very small,
Some stores don't even have tables,
You can only buy and take away to drink.
Its price is very cheap,
Guess how much?
9.9 RMB per cup,
which is about 1.4 USD.
It's really too cheap!
Although it's sold cheaply,
its coffee beans are very good,
The taste, hmm, is also very good.

fullTextZH: 所以很多爱喝咖啡的、上班的人、
fullTextEN: So many coffee lovers, office workers,

fullTextZH: 学生，都愿意买瑞幸的咖啡。
fullTextEN: and students are willing to buy Luckin's coffee.

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢瑞幸咖啡的原因是，
fullTextEN: The reason I like Luckin Coffee is,

fullTextZH: 他们把各种果汁加到咖啡里，
fullTextEN: they add various juices to the coffee,

fullTextZH: 让咖啡的味道，嗯，变得很丰富，
fullTextEN: making the coffee taste, hmm, very rich,
which really surprised me.

fullTextZH: 特别是他们做了一款生椰拿铁，
fullTextEN: Especially when they made a raw coconut latte,

fullTextZH: 就是把椰子的肉和咖啡混在一起。
fullTextEN: It's just mixing coconut meat with coffee.
As soon as this coffee came out,
it became popular instantly.
It has the aroma of coconut,
Hmm, not bitter at all,
suits the taste of Chinese people.
Many people like to drink it.

fullTextZH: 到现在，这款咖啡已经卖了十几亿杯了，
fullTextEN: Up to now, this coffee has sold over a billion cups,
very impressive!

fullTextZH: 后来，瑞幸就不停地做新口味的咖啡，
fullTextEN: Later, Luckin kept making new coffee flavors,

fullTextZH: 比如把橙子汁加到咖啡里，
fullTextEN: such as adding orange juice to coffee,
to make Orange C Americano;

fullTextZH: 把抹茶加到牛奶和咖啡里，
fullTextEN: adding matcha to milk and coffee,
to make matcha latte.

fullTextZH: 这些新口味，让大家都想来尝试一下，
fullTextEN: These new flavors make everyone want to try them,
Hmm, after drinking, they want more.

fullTextZH: 所以，瑞幸所有的咖啡品种，我基本上都喝过。
fullTextEN: So, I've basically tried all of Luckin's coffee varieties.
My favorite is Orange C.

fullTextZH: 虽然现在中国有很多很多的咖啡店，
fullTextEN: Although there are many coffee shops in China now,
but in my heart,
Luckin is the best,
It's number one.

fullTextZH: 还有一个原因让我很爱它，
fullTextEN: There's another reason I love it,

fullTextZH: 就是买瑞幸咖啡特别方便。
fullTextEN: which is that buying Luckin coffee is very convenient.
Luckin made a mobile app,

fullTextZH: 你不用走到店里去排队，
fullTextEN: You don't need to go to the store and queue,
Just tap a few times on your phone,
Choose the coffee flavor,
whether you want it hot or iced,

fullTextZH: 付完钱就可以等着拿咖啡了。
fullTextEN: After paying, you can just wait for the coffee.
There are many Luckin stores,

fullTextZH: 距离你几百米可能就会有一个店。
fullTextEN: There might be a store just a few hundred meters from you.
Sometimes, when you're at home, um,
and don't want to go out,
you can also order delivery,

fullTextZH: 他们会把咖啡送到你家，
fullTextEN: They will deliver the coffee to your home,
It's really very convenient!

fullTextZH: 所以让很多人每天都需要瑞幸、
fullTextEN: So many people need Luckin every day,
and can't live without Luckin.

fullTextZH: 但是，因为它卖得很便宜，
fullTextEN: However, because it's sold very cheaply,
So some people feel that,

fullTextZH: 瑞幸咖啡不是真的咖啡，
fullTextEN: Luckin Coffee is not real coffee,

fullTextZH: 更像是，嗯，咖啡味道的饮料之类的。
fullTextEN: more like, um, a coffee-flavored drink or something.

fullTextZH: 还有很多小的咖啡店很讨厌瑞幸，
fullTextEN: Many small coffee shops dislike Luckin,

fullTextZH: 觉得它的价格让其他的咖啡店很难、
fullTextEN: feeling its prices make it hard for other coffee shops,
hard to make money.

fullTextZH: 我有几个很爱喝咖啡的朋友，
fullTextEN: I have a few friends who love coffee,
they don't like drinking Luckin,

fullTextZH: 他们喜欢去小咖啡店喝咖啡。
fullTextEN: they prefer going to small coffee shops to drink coffee.

fullTextZH: 最后一个原因让我疯狂地爱它，
fullTextEN: The last reason makes me love it madly,

fullTextZH: 瑞幸经常和有名的卡通、电影合作，
fullTextEN: Luckin often collaborates with famous cartoons and movies,

fullTextZH: 你看，这个就是它和小黄人的联名，
fullTextEN: Look, this is its collaboration with the Minions,

fullTextZH: 杯子上面就有小黄人的图案，
fullTextEN: there are Minions' patterns on the cup,
especially cute,
I really like it.
Luckin's stores are increasing,
by the year 2025,

fullTextZH: 它的店已经有两万九千多家了，
fullTextEN: its stores will have over 29,000 locations,

fullTextZH: 比星巴克在中国的店多了很多。
fullTextEN: much more than Starbucks in China.

fullTextZH: 不管你是去中国的北京、上海，
fullTextEN: Whether you go to Beijing or Shanghai in China,
Even in the rural areas of China,
you can find Luckin stores.

fullTextZH: 瑞幸今年在纽约开了店。
fullTextEN: Luckin opened a store in New York this year.
In many of the videos I saw,

fullTextZH: 纽约的店生意也很不错哦，
fullTextEN: the New York store's business is also quite good,
because it's really too cheap.

fullTextZH: 纽约的价格是1.99美金一杯。
fullTextEN: The price in New York is $1.99 per cup.
I am also very happy,

fullTextZH: 自己喜欢的中国咖啡品牌，
fullTextEN: that my favorite Chinese coffee brand,
has already gone global.
After listening to this story,

fullTextZH: 你是不是也想尝一尝瑞幸的咖啡？
fullTextEN: do you also want to try Luckin's coffee?
If you come to China,

fullTextZH: 一定要去店里买一杯尝一尝，
fullTextEN: you must go to the store and buy a cup to try,
I highly recommend it.

fullTextZH: 今天的内容就到这里啦。
fullTextEN: That's all for today's content.
Do you like drinking coffee?
Like it or not,
why?

fullTextZH: 你们国家有很火的咖啡品牌吗？
fullTextEN: Does your country have a popular coffee brand?
Feel free to tell me in the comments.
See you next time, bye!
